title: Kicked Dense Greek Feta Tiropita
description: A dense and flavorful Greek dish featuring feta cheese, dried cherries, and a rich deglaze fond, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, eggs, melted butter, salt, and black pepper.
Add the crumbled feta cheese and dried cherries to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Roll out the mixture into a large tiropita shape, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the tiropita on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with olive oil.
Bake the tiropita for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the tiropita is baking, heat the red wine in a small saucepan over medium heat until reduced to a thick deglaze fond.
Remove the tiropita from the oven and brush with the deglaze fond.
Return the tiropita to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the fond is caramelized.
